item.title: When NotebookLM cannot import a YouTube link: export captions with BYTE
item.description: Try direct import first. If captions are available, use BYTE to save a Markdown reference, inspect it, and add the file instead. Includes a real export example.

item.title: Use BYTE to export a YouTube transcript and turn it into useful notes
item.description: Choose Markdown, retain source details and timestamps, export available captions with BYTE, then keep your own notes separate from the transcript.
